sourceKind: unmodified scratch simulator files before packaging
adaptations: ROOT defaults to the repository working directory or explicit environment variable.
tool.sh resolves its own location, reads ROOT as JSON from run metadata and loads existing tsx and its package tsconfig through mise without requiring a repository working directory.
render.mts removes three unused scratch imports and adds the existing optional request source field to its local TypeScript shape; rendering behavior is unchanged.
Grading retains the original runner's experimental-import-meta-resolve flag for root-relative ESM dependency resolution.
Executor instructions clarify CLI roleplay scope and retain active-tool-only, fixture-failure and persistence rules.
README documents actual imports, outputs and measurement exclusions; no trial results are included.
